name: payment_confirm
description: Protected. Approve the waiting payment with the 6-digit code the caller reads or texts you (the phone prompt, or the code texted for a card on screen). Never a PIN: mobile money PINs are typed on the payment card. Three wrong codes or 5 minutes decline it. In the resident app, while the payment card waits for a choice, call it with method (and no code) when the resident tells you how to pay.

code.description: The 6 digits the caller gave you

method.description: Only while the payment card waits for a choice and the resident tells you how to pay: card (a code is texted, they read it to you) or mobile_money (they type the PIN on the card). Leave out otherwise.
